source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 1 Grammar in Use:限制性定语从句(who/whom/that/which/whose)。句子地道、自然/动物主题、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项),零术语应用题。

points.overview: 先行词指人:从句缺主语用 who;从句缺宾语用 whom(口语/非正式也可 who),不可用 which。
先行词指物(限制性定语从句):缺主语或宾语用 which 或 that,不可用 who/whose。

points.point: whose(所属)· 介词 + which / whom
points.overview: 表所属关系(……的)用 whose + 名词,指人指物皆可;关系词作介词宾语提前时,指物用「介词+which」、指人用「介词+whom」,介词后不可用 that。

questions.stem: The young man ____ explained the mystery had grown up near the king's gardens.
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: It was a wise nobleman ____ first noticed that the gardens were empty.
questions.explanation: 先行词 nobleman 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: People ____ love nature often feel calm when they walk in a forest.
questions.explanation: 先行词 people 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: Scientists ____ study wild animals warn us about the loss of species.
questions.explanation: 先行词 scientists 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The farmer ____ planted the old tree saved the beauty of the gardens.
questions.explanation: 先行词 farmer 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: Children ____ spend time outdoors learn to care about nature.
questions.explanation: 先行词 children 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The expert ____ the reporter spoke to studies the balance of nature.
questions.explanation: 先行词 expert 指人、从句缺宾语(spoke to ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The guide ____ we met at the zoo knows every animal by name.
questions.explanation: 先行词 guide 指人、从句缺宾语(met ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The advisers ____ the king sent for could not solve the problem.
questions.explanation: 先行词 advisers 指人、从句缺宾语(sent for ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The volunteers ____ work at the park help to protect rare birds.
questions.explanation: 先行词 volunteers 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: He is the only person ____ truly understands how the forest lives.
questions.explanation: 先行词 person 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The poet ____ many readers admire wrote about the beauty of spring.
questions.explanation: 先行词 poet 指人、从句缺宾语(admire ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The neighbours ____ care for the woods often plant new trees there.
questions.explanation: 先行词 neighbours 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: A gardener ____ loves plants will treat every flower with care.
questions.explanation: 先行词 gardener 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The friends ____ I invited to the lake enjoyed watching the wild ducks.
questions.explanation: 先行词 friends 指人、从句缺宾语(invited ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The students ____ the teacher praised had cleaned up the river bank.
questions.explanation: 先行词 students 指人、从句缺宾语(praised ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The king listened to the man ____ everyone else had laughed at.
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人、从句缺宾语(laughed at ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The workers ____ built the new park left a space for the trees.
questions.explanation: 先行词 workers 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The travellers ____ we guided through the woods saw a family of deer.
questions.explanation: 先行词 travellers 指人、从句缺宾语(guided ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: Anyone ____ destroys a forest may harm the balance of nature.
questions.explanation: 先行词 anyone 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The old tree ____ stood in the middle of the gardens was cut down.
questions.explanation: 先行词 tree 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The plants ____ grow here are native to this part of the world.
questions.explanation: 先行词 plants 指物、从句缺主语 → that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The garden ____ the king destroyed could not be restored quickly.
questions.explanation: 先行词 garden 指物、从句缺宾语(destroyed ___)→ which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The river ____ flows past our town is home to many fish.
questions.explanation: 先行词 river 指物、从句缺主语 → that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: These are the moths ____ keep the whole garden alive and colourful.
questions.explanation: 先行词 moths 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The book ____ I read described how nature keeps its balance.
questions.explanation: 先行词 book 指物、从句缺宾语(read ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The forests ____ once covered this area have now been destroyed.
questions.explanation: 先行词 forests 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The flowers ____ the children picked soon withered in the sun.
questions.explanation: 先行词 flowers 指物、从句缺宾语(picked ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The lake ____ lies beyond the hills freezes hard every winter.
questions.explanation: 先行词 lake 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The painting ____ shows a snowy landscape hangs in the hall.
questions.explanation: 先行词 painting 指物、从句缺主语 → that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The seeds ____ the wind carried away grew into tall trees.
questions.explanation: 先行词 seeds 指物、从句缺宾语(carried ___)→ which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The rare bird ____ we saw at dawn has almost disappeared.
questions.explanation: 先行词 bird 指物(动物)、从句缺宾语(saw ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The fountains ____ replaced the old tree looked beautiful at first.
questions.explanation: 先行词 fountains 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The story ____ the young man told changed the way the king thought.
questions.explanation: 先行词 story 指物、从句缺宾语(told ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The mountains ____ surround the valley keep it warm in spring.
questions.explanation: 先行词 mountains 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The food ____ the animals could not find in the zoo was easy to get in the wild.
questions.explanation: 先行词 food 指物、从句缺宾语(find ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The clouds ____ gathered above the sea soon turned the sky grey.
questions.explanation: 先行词 clouds 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The habitat ____ the new park created saved several rare species.
questions.explanation: 先行词 habitat 指物、从句缺宾语(created ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The wild grass ____ covers the field turns golden in autumn.
questions.explanation: 先行词 grass 指物、从句缺主语 → which(也可 that)。

questions.stem: The photos ____ she took of the sunset filled the whole album.
questions.explanation: 先行词 photos 指物、从句缺宾语(took ___)→ that(也可 which)。

questions.stem: The king offered a reward to anyone ____ solution would be effective.
questions.explanation: 表所属(……的 solution)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: We protect animals ____ homes have been destroyed by pollution.
questions.explanation: 表所属(动物的 homes)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: These were the bones on ____ ancient symbols had been carved.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指物 → which(不可用 that)。

questions.stem: He is the scientist to ____ the rare plant was first sent.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: The girl ____ photo of the forest won the prize loves nature.
questions.explanation: 表所属(女孩的 photo)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: I visited a village ____ people still live close to nature.
questions.explanation: 表所属(村庄的 people)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: Nature is the means by ____ the seasons renew the earth.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: She is the expert with ____ we discussed the loss of species.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: It was a tree ____ branches reached high above the garden wall.
questions.explanation: 表所属(树的 branches)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: We met a farmer ____ land had once been a barren hillside.
questions.explanation: 表所属(农夫的 land)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: This is the river in ____ many kinds of fish make their home.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: He is the writer for ____ the beauty of nature was a favourite subject.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: They saved a bird ____ wing had been hurt by a sharp branch.
questions.explanation: 表所属(鸟的 wing)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: We studied a plant ____ leaves change colour with the climate.
questions.explanation: 表所属(植物的 leaves)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: That is the hill on ____ a clump of wild flowers grows each spring.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: He is the guide from ____ I learned how the forest keeps its balance.
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: The king destroyed a tree ____ roots had quietly fed the whole garden.
questions.explanation: 表所属(树的 roots)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: We helped a family ____ garden had been ruined by the storm.
questions.explanation: 表所属(一家人的 garden)→ whose + 名词。

questions.stem: This is the lake beside ____ the old palace once stood.
questions.explanation: 介词 beside 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: She is the teacher to ____ the children showed their nature drawings.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。
